subject: revit

milestone.title: Rooms
milestone.objective: Place and name a room in every ground-floor space, with area tags, in 15 minutes

sources.title: Revit Help: Rooms (fixture)
sources.text: A room is a space bounded by room-bounding elements such as walls, floors and room separation lines. On the Architecture tab, Room & Area panel, click Room (keyboard shortcut RM). Select Tag on Placement on the Modify | Place Room tab to tag rooms as you place them. Click inside an enclosed area to place a room. To divide an open space without a wall, for example a kitchen open to a living room, use Room Separator on the Room & Area panel and draw a line across the opening. To name a room, double-click the name in its tag or change Name in the Properties palette. Revit calculates the room's area from its boundaries; choose a room tag type that shows the area to display it.

lesson_lines: A room is a space enclosed by room-bounding elements such as walls and room separation lines.
1. Architecture tab, Room & Area panel: click **Room** (shortcut RM).
2. Turn on **Tag on Placement** on the Modify | Place Room tab.
Your kitchen opens onto the living room with no wall between them. Use **Room Separator** (Room & Area panel) and draw a line across the opening, then place one room on each side.
Double-click the name in the tag, or change **Name** in the Properties palette. Revit calculates each room's area from its boundaries; pick a room tag type that shows the area.
Place, name and tag a room in every ground-floor space, with the area visible on each tag.
